verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a CLI with a universal `--json` flag producing clean stdout/empty stderr for scripting (maritime-docs-9), a Bearer-token API/CLI auth model suitable for non-interactive use (maritime-docs-8, maritime-docs-4), cron triggers to wake agents on schedule (maritime-docs-10), webhooks for event-driven automation instead of polling (maritime-docs-3), and bulk .env/stdin config import with hot-reload (maritime-docs-11) — together these cover headless/CI-style operation well. Missing for 10: an independent or hands-on example of an actual CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) using the CLI/API end-to-end.
